# Real verification inputs (`test/fixtures/`)

This directory holds **real, authorised, sanitised inputs** for `npm run test:real`
(`scripts/verify-real.ts`). Nothing in it is generated by the code base and nothing is committed
except this README (`.gitignore` excludes the rest). The runner refuses to invent substitutes:
without `manifest.json` it exits with `FAIL REAL_INPUT_MISSING`.

The separately authorized mock setup uses `npm test` and stores its generated files under `.runtime/setup-tests/`. This directory remains reserved for real inputs.

## Why this verifier requires real fixtures

The parsers (PDF auditor, PKCS#12 inspector, geography normaliser) only prove anything when run
against the documents the firm really receives. Mocks and hand-made PDFs produced false confidence
in the past. A component with no real input is reported `NOT_VERIFIED` and the whole run fails.

## What to place here

| Input | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apoderamiento PDFs | Real justificantes from Sede Judicial, a court acta, a partner power | Sanitise only what the authorisation requires; keep the original page count and text layer. |
| Certificate (`.p12`/`.pfx`) | An authorised **test** certificate of a consenting person | Password is NEVER written to disk: export it in the shell under the variable named in the manifest. |
| Geo catalog (`.json`) | Reviewed transcription of the official partido-judicial list | Schema: `GeoCatalogSchema` in `src/core/geo-normalizer.ts`. |
| Expediente identities | Exported from the real database (id, DNI, name, phone, Kmaleon id) | Used as the snapshot for the deterministic engine chain. |

Every file is pinned by SHA-256 in the manifest; a mismatch fails the run.

## `manifest.json`

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "authorization": {
    "authorizedBy": "Name of the person authorising local use",
    "authorizedAt": "2026-09-14T10:00:00+02:00",
    "reference": "ticket-or-email-reference",
    "scope": "REAL_SANITIZED_INPUTS_FOR_LOCAL_VERIFICATION"
  },
  "airamFullName": "FULL NAME OF THE PROCURADOR AS PRINTED IN THE POWERS",
  "expedientes": [
    { "id": "uuid-from-db", "dni": "DNI_REAL_DEL_CLIENTE", "nombre": "…", "telefono": "34…", "kmaleonExpedienteId": "…", "identityVerified": true }
  ],
  "decisionReplays": [{ "file": "decision-real-exportada.json", "sha256": "HASH_REAL_DEL_ARCHIVO" }],
  "pdfs": [
    {
      "file": "apoderamiento-completo.pdf",
      "sha256": "…64 hex…",
      "expectedDni": "DNI_REAL_DEL_CLIENTE",
      "description": "Complete power, five pages, all representatives",
      "expected": { "status": "VALID_FULL_5_PAGES", "isValid": true, "canViabilize": false, "hasAiram": true, "identityMatches": true, "pageCount": 5, "missingPowers": [] }
    },
    {
      "file": "apoderamiento-provisional.pdf",
      "sha256": "…",
      "expectedDni": "DNI_REAL_DEL_CLIENTE",
      "expected": { "status": "DEFECTIVE_WITH_AIRAM", "isValid": false, "canViabilize": true, "hasAiram": true, "identityMatches": true, "pageCount": 3 }
    },
    {
      "file": "apoderamiento-sin-airam.pdf",
      "sha256": "…",
      "expectedDni": "DNI_REAL_DEL_CLIENTE",
      "expected": { "status": "DEFECTIVE_NO_AIRAM", "isValid": false, "canViabilize": false, "hasAiram": false, "identityMatches": true, "pageCount": 5 }
    }
  ],
  "certificates": [
    { "file": "test-cert.p12", "sha256": "…", "passwordEnv": "APOD_TEST_CERT_PASSWORD", "expectedDni": "DNI_REAL_DEL_CLIENTE", "expected": { "usable": true, "identityMatches": true, "expired": false } }
  ],
  "geo": {
    "catalogFile": "partidos-judiciales.json",
    "catalogSha256": "…",
    "cases": [
      { "input": { "codigoPostal": "28001", "provincia": "Madrid", "localidad": "Madrid" }, "expected": { "status": "RESOLVED", "partidoJudicial": "Madrid", "provinceIneCode": "28" } },
      { "input": { "codigoPostal": "28001", "provincia": "Barcelona", "localidad": "Madrid" }, "expected": { "status": "UNRESOLVED" } }
    ]
  }
}
```

Expected values must come from a human reading of each real document, not from running the
auditor and copying its output.

## Running

```bash
export APOD_TEST_CERT_PASSWORD='…'   # only in the shell, never in .env or the manifest
npm run test:real                              # or: npx tsx scripts/verify-real.ts test/fixtures/manifest.json
```

Results are written to `evidence/real-verification.json` (extracted PDF text and DNIs are never
written; identities are masked). Exit code 0 only when every component is `VERIFIED`.

## What this run does not prove

Live WhatsApp delivery, Kmaleon read-back, Apudata payments, Sede submissions, and the legal
sufficiency or signature authenticity of any document. Those need the configured adapters and
human review.

## Reproducción de decisiones reales

Cada archivo de `decisionReplays` contiene `{evidenceRef, recordedAt, snapshot, event, expectedDecision}` exportados de una decisión efectivamente observada. `snapshot` incluye todos los campos de Expediente tal como estaban antes del evento; las fechas son ISO. `event` conserva el tipo y carga observados, sin secretos. `expectedDecision` es el contrato de 11 campos registrado. La hora `recordedAt` debe ser la utilizada por esa evaluación. No crear estados, aprobaciones, eventos ni recibos ficticios para completar estos archivos. Los ejemplos anteriores describen el formato; sustituirlos por datos reales autorizados, no ejecutarlos como casos de prueba.
